About Us
हाम्रोबारे

किन Prerak Multipurpose?

किन Prerak Multipurpose?

Prerak Multipurpose Pvt. Ltd. is a Hetauda-based construction & interior services company offering complete solutions under one roof — building construction, interior design, UPVC/Aluminum, gypsum, plumbing, electrical, painting, renovation & material supply.

Prerak Multipurpose Pvt. Ltd. हेटौंडा, नेपालमा आधारित निर्माण तथा इन्टेरियर सेवा कम्पनी हो। घर तथा भवन निर्माण, इन्टेरियर डिजाइन, UPVC/Aluminum, जिप्सम, Plumbing, Electrical, Painting, Renovation तथा निर्माण सामग्री — एउटै ठाउँबाट।

🎨 Templates & Themes

About all the templates and how to use them

📋 What are Templates?

Templates are pre-built design themes for your website. Each template changes the colors, fonts, and layout style. You can switch templates anytime — your content (services, projects, pricing) stays the same!

💡 How to use: Click any template card below to apply it. Preview the live site → Save if you like → Or revert anytime.

📧 EmailJS Setup — Real OTP Email
emailjs.com →
EmailJS को free plan मा monthly 200 emails पाइन्छ। Setup गरेपछि admin login OTP directly email मा जान्छ।
OTP login codes will be sent to this email address.
✅ Saved!
Setup steps:
1️⃣ emailjs.com मा free account बनाउनुस्
2️⃣ Email Service add गर्नुस् (Gmail) → Service ID copy गर्नुस्
3️⃣ Email Template बनाउनुस् → variables: to_email, otp_code, company → Template ID copy
4️⃣ Account → API Keys → Public Key copy गर्नुस्
5️⃣ माथिका fields मा paste गर्नुस् → Save EmailJS → Send Test OTP गर्नुस्
